items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Homer Eugene played trombone. I was in the band. ... I played with three pieces. Harrison Verrett on piano, Homer Eugene on guitar and me on drums.

ctx.x: Yeah. So, uh, well, anyway, you played both those funerals. Yeah, I played both of them. What bands were there?

Kid Howard played each one. I was working with Kid Howard's band at the time. He had a regular brass band? Oh, yes. He had a regular brass band. And the name of his band was the Golden Leaf, the Silver Leaf Brass Band. That's it. Silver Leaf Brass Band. Remember who was in that band? Yeah, I'll see if I can call some of the fellas. Kid Howard was the leader. Sheik. Thomas Jefferson, that's the three trumpet players. Jim Little played bass. Jim Crow played trombone. Homer Eugene played trombone. I was in the band.…
Bras band. Bras band. Which brass band? Do you remember by any chance? I just...

items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Yeah, with Harrison Verrett Hall, Homer Eugenie and myself.

ctx.x: Uh, yeah, I think you told me just a minute.
Yeah, with Harrison Verrett Hall, Homer Eugenie and myself. But my first job on the street on a brass band was with Willie Parker. He's the first man brought me on the street.
Yeah, let's see. I wanted to get that kazoo band down there first. You had, what did you call it? Did you call it a kazoo band or what?
